description: Ohio SB 52 gives county commissioners veto power over large wind and solar projects approved by the Ohio Power Siting Board. As of 2023 more than half of Ohio counties had opted out.
Cooke County commissioners adopted an ordinance prohibiting commercial wind energy facilities in unincorporated areas of the county.
Kentucky SB 4 imposed a one-year moratorium on utility-scale wind and solar permitting pending a study by the Public Service Commission.
Invenergy canceled the 116 MW Shepherd's Run project in Sullivan County after sustained local opposition including a county resolution against the project and organized community campaigns.
Starke County commissioners denied a special exception permit for the 1650 MW Mammoth Solar project citing setback and land use concerns. The project was partially rerouted to neighboring counties.

Mason County passed a wind energy ordinance with setbacks that effectively banned turbines. A developer challenged the ordinance in state court arguing it was preempted by Michigan's zoning enabling act.

A coalition of fishing industry groups and coastal municipalities filed an appeal before the Virginia Supreme Court challenging the State Corporation Commission's approval of the Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project.
